This victory was pivotal in establishing him as a world-class player and is widely cited for its clarity of positional themes and attacking precision.

This was Magnus Carlsen's first win as a challenger in a World Championship match, marking a key turning point in his ascent to the chess throne. Against reigning World Champion Anand, Carlsen patiently ground out a win from a seemingly equal endgame, showcasing his legendary endgame prowess and psychological resilience. This game is widely cited as the moment Carlsen began to take firm control of the 2013 match.

positions.tournament: World Chess Championship (Game 12 rapid tiebreak, Game 1)
positions.significance: This game is from the rapid tiebreaks of the dramatic 2018 World Chess Championship, which followed a record 12 consecutive classical draws. Carlsen seized the initiative right from the opening, outplaying Caruana with energetic and accurate play to win the first rapid game, setting the tone for his successful title defense. The game is praised for Carlsen's dynamic treatment of the Alapin Sicilian.
